description: Invoice math in exact cents. Each line is quantity × unit price, then an optional line discount, rounded half away from zero to the cent. An invoice-level discount comes off the subtotal, then tax is that percent of the discounted subtotal, rounded the same way. Returns every line, the subtotal, discount, tax, and total. A discount larger than the amount it applies to is rejected. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/invoice-total

discountAmount.description: Invoice discount as money, instead of discountPct

discountPct.description: Invoice discount percent off the subtotal, default 0

lines.description: Each line: qty, unitPrice, optional description and discountPct

taxPct.description: Tax percent of the discounted subtotal, default 0

name: invoice_total
title: Invoice Total
